plan.goal: Detect a 1.0-sigma difference between two groups with 90% power at alpha 0.05
plan.rationale: Two-sample t-test design. Effect size of 1.0 sigma (effect_size = 1.0, std_dev = 1.0 in the same units) with two-sided alpha 0.05 and target power 0.9. The sample size calculator returns the required biological replicates per group.
caveats: n_per_group is computed from the raw inputs; the 22 per group assumes a two-sample t-test with equal group sizes and normally distributed data.
If the true effect is smaller than 1.0 sigma or the variance is larger than assumed, more replicates will be needed.
Consider whether a one-sided test is justified; the two-sided default is more conservative.

provenance.formula: n from two-sample t-test power equation
